parts.name: TooltipProvider
parts.description: Groups tooltips: once one has opened, moving to another opens it without the delay, and closes the first.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its tooltip opens, in ms. A trigger's own `delay` wins.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long after the pointer leaves before a tooltip closes, in ms. A trigger's own `closeDelay` wins.

props.name: timeout
props.description: After a tooltip closes, another opens at once if hovered within this many ms.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled tooltip doesn't open, and closes if it was open.

props.name: disableHoverablePopup
props.description: Whether the tooltip closes as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger, instead of letting it move onto the popup.

parts.name: TooltipTrigger
parts.description: Opens the tooltip on hover (after the delay) and on keyboard focus; closes it on leave, blur and press. It has no `popovertarget`: a press must not open a tooltip. Spread on any focusable element.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the tooltip opens, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long after the pointer leaves before it closes, in ms.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether pressing the trigger closes the tooltip.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and popup, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

parts.name: TooltipArrow
parts.description: Spread on an element inside the popup: it is placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger, and carries the popup's `data-side`. The shape (a rotated square, an SVG) is the stylesheet's.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.
